body.name: Gaussian-mixture Bayes envelope
body.construction: For \(\pi\in\Pi\), form \(A_{\pi,+}\), \(A_{\pi,-}\), and \(B_{\pi}=A_{\pi,+}-A_{\pi,-}\); the dual payoff is \(b(\pi)=\int_{\mathbb R^p}\min\{A_{\pi,+}(z),A_{\pi,-}(z)\}\,dz\), and its Bayes responses are exactly the rules with \(\delta(z)=1\) on \(\{B_{\pi}>0\}\), \(\delta(z)=0\) on \(\{B_{\pi}<0\}\), and arbitrary values in \([0,1]\) on \(\{B_{\pi}=0\}\).
